entries.en: to understand thoroughly; to be deeply versed in
to understand thoroughly; to be thoroughly conversant with
to comprehend; to awaken to (a truth)
entries.notes: R栏 ngin 与「悟」对音不合，L栏 comprelteca 疑为 comprehende 之讹，义依 H/M 定为「悟」。

entries.zh: 通晓，熟知，谙熟（事理、情况）
entries.en: to know well; to be thoroughly familiar with
entries.notes: H栏「語曉」不成词，M 栏 am、R 栏 ngan 均与「諳」相应，当作「諳曉」。

entries.en: to know; to understand
entries.notes: H「曉的」与 M「hiau tet」互证为「曉得」，R 栏 hian iy 对音不合。

entries.en: to grasp the meaning; to catch the sense

entries.zh: 高明，见识明达（看得透彻）
entries.en: clear-sighted; perspicacious
entries.notes: M栏末 claram[残]、R栏 com meng 对音不整，义依 H「高明」定。

entries.en: clearly; plainly; obviously
distinct; clear
to inspect and censure (officials); censorship
entries.notes: L栏 sabiam 一节讹脱难校，H「監察」与 M、R 两栏对音相合，义从汉字。

entries.zh: 智慧，聪明（领会所言所行之理）
entries.en: wisdom, intelligence; to grasp what is said or to be done
entries.notes: H栏作「志銳」，而 M「chy xue」、R「chy xui」均与「智慧」相应，L 义亦合，故从「智慧」解。

entries.zh: 点头就知机——稍一示意即明其意
entries.en: to catch on at a hint; to understand at a nod
entries.notes: M栏首音 [疑:tiam]、R栏末字 [残]，然 H 栏成语完整，M、R 之 tau/chiu 等音可校，义可定。

entries.en: discernment; to distinguish, to tell apart
entries.notes: R栏杂入 a fia taley.) 等残文，仅 (fun 可校，义依 H「分」与 M「hun」定。

entries.zh: 分晓，明白清楚（对事理了然）
entries.en: clear understanding; to be clear about

entries.zh: 心内极明——心中极为明白透彻
entries.en: inwardly most clear; lucid in mind
entries.notes: M、R 两栏后半（Lavo bun / m[残]）残损，义依前三字「心內極明」定。

entries.en: a whole thing; entire, complete
entries.notes: H栏「渾」带 [疑:渾/澤]，M「hun choan」表「渾全」，据此取完整义。

entries.zh: 齐全，完整无缺（一说「完全」）
entries.en: complete; all present and in order
entries.notes: H栏 [疑:膠/齊]，R栏 chuen 与 M「ca nuy」合于「齊全」，亦可能为「完全」，取齐备义。

entries.en: finished; complete; done
whole; entire; complete
wholeheartedly; single-mindedly
a set (of clothing); a suit; a complete set
entries.notes: L栏句末 [残]，R栏 [疑:tau]，然 H「套」与 M「to」相合，义可定。
